content.text:
I fixed one bug on the products page: the "Add to cart" and "Add bundle" buttons had white text on a white background, so they looked blank. I haven't looked at the page in a browser, and the 16 functional tests passed, but they wouldn't catch this kind of styling problem.

The cause was in `.btn-secondary` in `site/css/components.css`. Its text colour was set to `var(--color-surface)`, which is white, the same as the button's background. I changed it to `var(--color-ink)`.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what "the last change" was. I read the products page markup and the CSS it uses (`tokens.css`, `pages.css`, `components.css`) and found nothing else wrong. If you're seeing something else, such as a layout or spacing problem, tell me what and I'll look again.

STATUS: DONE
